writtenTo: Jewish Christians tempted to return to Judaism
importantNotes: The 'Hall of Faith' (ch. 11) is the most comprehensive catalog of faith heroes in Scripture.
'Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever' (13:8).
'The word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword' (4:12).
The five warning passages (2:1-4, 3:7-4:13, 5:11-6:12, 10:26-39, 12:14-29) are heavily debated.
The argument: why go back to shadows when you have the reality in Christ?

chapters.1: Jesus is superior to angels — He is God's Son, the radiance of God's glory.
chapters.2: Warning against drifting; Jesus became human to save humanity through His death.
chapters.3: Jesus is greater than Moses; warning against unbelief — don't harden your hearts.
chapters.4: Enter God's rest through faith; the word of God is living and active; Jesus our sympathetic High Priest.
chapters.5: Jesus is a priest in the order of Melchizedek; the readers are spiritually immature.
chapters.6: Warning against falling away; God's promises are certain — an anchor for the soul.
chapters.7: Melchizedek and Christ — Jesus is a priest forever, superior to the Levitical priesthood.
chapters.8: The new covenant is superior to the old — God will write His laws on their hearts.
chapters.9: The earthly tabernacle was a shadow; Christ entered the heavenly sanctuary with His own blood.
chapters.10: Christ's sacrifice is once for all; let us draw near with confidence; do not shrink back.
chapters.11: The Hall of Faith — Abel, Noah, Abraham, Moses, Rahab, and many more who lived by faith.
chapters.12: Run the race with endurance, looking to Jesus; God disciplines those He loves; the unshakeable kingdom.
chapters.13: Practical exhortations — love, hospitality, marriage, contentment; Jesus Christ is the same forever.
